title: Technical Machine Blindside Reverse Holo Uncommon 176/182 Paradox Rift Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Technical Machine Blindside card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon collector. With an Uncommon rarity and Reverse Holo finish, this card is a true gem. The card features the beloved character Blindside and is part of the SV04: Paradox Rift set. 

As a Collectible Card Game, this card is perfect for any fan of the genre. The card number is 176/182 and it is a Pokémon type card. Don't miss your chance to add this amazing card to your collection.
